notes: Derke now uses the same lightweight OMEGA PC structure as Ponyboy and Zach rather than remaining an all-10s empty actor shell.
Derke is Power Level 2 with 24 HP, AC 15, 30 ft Speed, STR 14, DEX 16, CON 14, INT 12, WIS 13, CHA 10.
Derke has Dexterity and Constitution save proficiency and one trained skill: Acrobatics.
Derke receives exactly one generated personal feature: Kinetic Shift.
Kinetic Shift: 2/Long Rest; after Derke hits with an attack, he can move up to 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

Derke starts with Cyberware Capacity 3 and zero installed chrome in the one-time build migration. Future loader runs preserve his live chrome progression and current HP/stat edits instead of resetting them.
The build is versioned and only applies the canonical baseline once; the importer still repairs identity, folder, portrait, token, cache, and ADK roster scaffolding afterward.
